propositions: The gerrit-verify build-and-test step is slow (~32-42 min wall clock), dominated by the serial test matrix.
Running the default suite under pytest-xdist (-n4 worksteal) is ~5x faster with byte-identical test outcomes to serial.
Coverage must be kept on the gate and combined under xdist (parallel=true) to equal the serial value and stay at or above fail_under=70.
No pip caching exists, so the heavy .[dev]/[agents] dependency stack is rebuilt every job; adding cache halves install time on repeat runs.
Per-test performance logging via --durations should be baked into the gate to log slowest tests, optionally storing .test_durations.
docs/coverage.md and CI docs must be updated to note the xdist coverage-combine requirement.
